name: Motion Blur via Sub-frame Optimization
definition: A method to model motion blur in radiance fields by approximating the continuous integral of ray accumulation over the shutter open time as a finite sum of N intermediate sub-frames, jointly optimizing sub-frame camera poses with the radiance field.
summary: Motion Blur via Sub-frame Optimization models radiance field blur by jointly optimizing independent sub-frame camera poses, enabling arbitrary smooth local motion unlike global trajectory methods.
